title: Exit load surprise
text: Redeemed my mutual fund after 8 months and they deducted some amount. Nobody told me about exit load. Feels like a hidden charge.

title: Good app
text: The chat assistant answered my query about step-up SIP quickly. Nice to have help inside the app.

title: App hangs at market open
text: App freezes for a minute right at 9:15 during market open. Order got delayed and I missed my price.

title: Why was money deducted?
text: I switched from one fund to another within 30 days and got charged. Switchout also attracts exit load? No one explains this before you click redeem.

title: Love the SIP reminders
text: I get reminders before each SIP instalment. Very easy to track my SIPs now.

title: AMC charge confusion
text: I see a demat AMC charge deduction of 75 rupees every year. I thought it would be zero. Where was this disclosed?

title: KYC video call failed
text: Video KYC kept failing yesterday, screen froze mid-call. Took 3 attempts to complete.

title: Exit load charged on 11th month
text: Held a fund for 11 months and exited. They took 0.5% exit load. This should be shown when I place the redemption order itself.

title: Clean interface
text: Mutual fund dashboard looks clean now. Redeem button is easier to find.

title: Stamp duty everywhere
text: Every buy order shows a tiny stamp duty line item. I know it's small but why is it there? Is this a new tax?

title: Position stuck after app crash
text: App crashed while placing a sell order. On reopening the position was still showing. This is scary during intraday.

title: Cheated on redemption
text: They deducted exit load without any popup explanation and the support bot just links a help article. Very disappointing.

title: Best for beginners
text: Started investing through the chat assistant. It explained AMC, STT and brokerage in simple language.

title: DP charges not clear
text: Charged 15.93 as DP charges on selling shares. I did not see this mentioned anywhere before I sold.

title: Fast customer care
text: Support resolved my bank update issue within an hour. Good experience.

title: Exit load on SIP units
text: Each SIP instalment has its own 1-year window for exit load. I thought it was from when I started the SIP. Redemption got hit hard.

title: Mutual fund search improved
text: Search and fund comparison has improved a lot. Very easy to switch between funds.

title: Hidden charges in beauty
text: I love the interface but the charges page is buried. I had no idea about exit load until I redeemed and saw less money.

title: Order lag on mobile data
text: On 4G the order placement takes 8-10 seconds. Works fine on wifi. Data saver mode should not slow trading.

title: AMC waived then charged
text: First year AMC was free so I never bothered. Now suddenly 75 is debited. At least warn before deducting.

title: Misleading zero broker claim
text: You advertise zero brokerage for delivery but then there is STT, stamp duty, DP charges. At least show a realistic upfront cost estimate.

title: Good option chain
text: Options chain is fast on my phone. Great for trading on the go.

title: SIP stop not instant
text: Stopped a SIP and it still took one more instalment. The chat confirmed it in the end but the delay confused me.

title: Exit load rude surprise
text: Redeemed 2.5 lakh from a small cap fund at 11th month. Lost almost 2500 in exit load. Nowhere was I told this clearly.

title: Demat account simple
text: Opening a demat account and KYC was very smooth. Video call took 2 minutes.

title: Redemption amount mismatch
text: Redeemed an equity fund and the credited amount was less than what NAV suggested. Called support and they said exit load. This needs better transparency.

title: Switch button hidden
text: Fund switching is hard to find. Took me a while to figure out where the switch option is.

title: Every year a charge
text: I keep getting charged 75 rupees AMC every year for demat. I know it's small but it was shown as free when I started.

title: Fraud or fee?
text: I am still not sure if the deduction at redemption was a fee or a fraud. The receipt does not say Exit Load anywhere. Fix the receipt.

title: Notifications on time
text: SIP success and failed notifications come instantly now. Useful.

title: Search takes time
text: Fund search is slow when there is strong volatility. Lags behind the market a lot.

title: Exit load not shown on order
text: When I place a redeem order there is no mention of exit load. Only after processing do I see the deduction. Why not show it upfront?

title: Feels like a hidden fee
text: Charging exit load on month 12 redemptions is basically a hidden fee. At least show a warning box before I confirm.

title: Chat solves my doubts
text: The in-app chat is great. It explained brokerage and DP charges to me line by line.

title: Bank verification slow
text: Adding a new bank account took 2 days for the micro deposit verification. Could be faster.

title: AMC email surprise
text: Got an email about AMC deduction without any prior warning in the app. These auto-debits should be told in advance.

title: Fast IPO allotment updates
text: IPO allotment and refund updates were timely. Good experience.

title: Stopped trusting
text: Repeated deductions I could not understand. Exit load, AMC, DP charges all different. I stopped trusting the app.

title: Laggy charts
text: Charts freeze on 1 minute timeframe during heavy volume. Very laggy.

title: Good for long term
text: Simple way to build a monthly SIP. I use the chat to pick funds based on my risk.

title: Exit load explanation patchy
text: The explainer says exit load depends on holding period but does not say the exact % for my fund. I had to check the scheme document.

title: Wrong redemption amount
text: Redeemed and got less money than the amount shown on screen. Exit load was not shown during the flow. Please fix.

title: Transparency improved
text: Now the redeem screen shows an approximate exit load before confirming. Much better than before.

title: AMC vs brokerage
text: The app mixes up AMC charges and brokerage in one page. Hard to know what is charged when.

title: Support ticket works
text: Raised a ticket through the app and got a detailed reply about exit load on SIP. Good follow-up.

title: SIP pause feature needed
text: There is no easy way to skip one SIP instalment. Asked chat and it said pause is not available for all funds.

title: Never mentioned exit load
text: When I started the SIP nobody ever mentioned exit load could apply to each instalment. Now I know why my redemption was less.

title: Trade book slow
text: Trade book takes time to load after a high volume day. Waiting for entries is annoying.

title: MF switch easy now
text: Switching between funds is easier now with clear confirmation.

title: DP charge surprise again
text: I sell shares rarely and each time I forget the DP charge. Wish the app reminded me of charges before confirming the sell.

title: Receipt unclear
text: My redemption receipt just shows net amount. No break-up of exit load. I want to see gross, load, and net clearly.

title: Transparent now
text: I can see DP charge estimate before selling. This is how it should be.

title: Chart indicator missing
text: Missing RSI on the default mobile charts. Need more indicators quickly.

title: Exit load per SIP instalment
text: My SIP has completed 14 months but some instalments are recent, and exit load applies per instalment. The app shows total holding 14 months and misleads me.

title: App fast after update
text: The new update feels snappier. Order placement on market open is better now.

title: Charged twice
text: I redeemed once and saw two deductions - exit load and some tax. The app never told me. Unacceptable.

title: Portfolio sync delay
text: Portfolio NAV updates are late sometimes. It shows yesterday NAV for a long time.

title: AMC charge without notice
text: Auto-debited AMC charge with no in-app notification beforehand. Surprised on bank statement.

title: Great support chat
text: Chat agent explained exit load and STT in plain words. Wish this was visible before placing the order too.

title: Good app overall
text: Minor issues but overall very good investing app for mutual funds and stocks.

title: Redemption flow hides fee
text: The redeem flow shows price and units but not the exit load. I only discover it after the units are debited.

title: Nothing about exit load at purchase
text: At purchase the scheme page shows exit load in tiny text. New investors like me miss it completely.

title: Watchlist syncing bug
text: Watchlist does not sync between phone and web sometimes.

title: Explain AMC better
text: I understand AMC now but only after calling support. App should explain it in the charges section itself.

title: Smooth onboarding
text: New KYC flow with video is much faster. Completed in a few minutes.

title: Fund filter too basic
text: Filtering funds by exit load and expense ratio should be easier. Need better filters.

title: Lost money to exit load
text: Redeemed earned money after 10 months and lost 1.5% to exit load. Never clearly told. Very unhappy.

title: Intraday fast exit works
text: Fast exit worked beautifully during crash. Filled instantly.

title: Stamp duty confusion
text: Small stamp duty on every order confuses my statement. Hard to reconcile total charges of the day.

title: Tip during peak hours
text: App gets slow during peak lunch hours. Watch pages refresh slowly.

title: MF comparison improved
text: Comparing two funds now shows exit load and expense ratio side by side. Useful.

title: Exit load calculator missing
text: Please add an exit load calculator in the app. Users should see the impact before redeeming.

title: Support bot unhelpful for fees
text: Asked the bot why I was charged exit load and it just pasted a generic article. Need a personalized answer based on my fund.

title: Good
text: No complaints. App works fine for my needs.

title: AMC auto debit shocks
text: AMC auto debit without prior app alert is a shock. At least show a countdown before the charge date.

title: Exit load felt like theft
text: I did not understand why my redemption amount was less. Felt like theft until support explained it is exit load. Show it while placing order!

title: SIP name change request
text: Would like custom names for SIPs to track different goals.

title: DP charge estimate shown
text: Now the app shows DP charge estimate before selling. Good transparency improvement.

title: Receipt still unclear for fees
text: The redemption receipt does not split exit load clearly. Net amount only. Please add a charge line.

title: Slight lag in holdings
text: Holdings page lags when the market is very volatile. Refresh takes 3-4 seconds.

title: Exit load disclosure weak
text: Disclosure exists but is buried in scheme documents. Should be a one-line upfront note on the redeem button.

title: Best app for MF investors
text: I moved all my MF investments here. Clear tracking and low friction.

title: Compounding calculator
text: Would love a fee impact calculator for redemption to plan exits better.

title: Told nothing about load
text: Was told nothing about exit load at the time of either investment or redemption. Found out only from my bank statement.

title: Good for options
text: Options trading works smoothly. Execution is fast enough.

title: AMC + DP on one screen confusing
text: AMC and DP charges shown together confuse me. I could not tell which one was deducted.

title: Exit load after 11 months again
text: 11 months and 20 days holding, still charged exit load because it counts from each SIP instalment. This is frustrating and not explained.

title: Fine but fees page hidden
text: The fees page exists but is too hidden. Most users discover fees after being charged.

title: Great improvements
text: Redemption screen improvements and chat support are both great this month.

title: Repeat exit load confusion
text: Every month someone asks about exit load on Support. Please make it a prominent and simple explainer inside the redeem flow.

title: Works well now
text: No issues so far. Everything I need for my monthly SIPs works.

title: Deducted without asking
text: Money deducted on redemption without my understanding. I only learned about exit load after contacting support. Needs upfront clarity.
